messages:
Mona: follow-up from the postmortem - we should convert action items into small, testable changes. focus: (1) dedupe/grouping, (2) threshold baselines, (3) paging cadence/runbook. who volunteers?
Raj: I can own dedupe/grouping. plan: start with group_by [service, region] + group_interval=7m, repeat_interval=20m. will prototype on kv-cache and report duplication rate.
Felix: I'll take thresholds. approach: compute a 21d rolling baseline per-region, set warning=mean+2sigma, page=mean+4sigma, and require 2 evals in 6m to page. will publish numbers to the ticket.
ops-bot: created ticket ALERT-21011 assigned to Raj (dedupe) and ALERT-21012 assigned to Felix (thresholds). Links: https://redwood/ALERT-21011, https://redwood/ALERT-21012
Raj: implementation note: will add a pre-filter to drop identical instance-origin alerts within 3m and add an Alertmanager inhibit for known warmup tags. PR will be small and limited to staging first.
Felix: also propose adding a scale_event label from the autoscaler. map scale_event=true to warning-only for 4m. reduces pages during node churn.
Mona: timeline: Raj due 2026-04-09, Felix due 2026-04-16. weekly sync Wed 11:00 PT. I'll add owners to the postmortem follow-up table and create the recurring invite.
pager-bot: temporary 2h silence applied to kv-cache-5xx for validation window.
Raj: canary plan: enable dedupe in staging for 48h, measure unique_alerts vs total_alerts. if dup rate drops >50% we expand to prod with a 10% node ramp.
Felix: I'll share baseline CSV and a small dashboard widget showing unique alerts, dup rate, and paging volume. updates go in ticket comments only.
Mona: perfect. keep changes scoped and measurable. add the sample logs to the postmortem and record the follow-up table updates. thanks :thumbsup:
